slides.sub: He was told to destroy a song. He built a bridge instead.
A music writer, before anything else.

text: He gets his first DJ booking
slides.sub: From the page to the booth.

text: Primal Scream were a guitar band.
He reviewed their album in the zine.
He liked it. They met at a party.
They asked him to remix a song
called "I'm Losing More Than I'll Ever Have."
slides.sub: A remix request from a band he'd written about.

slides.note: The band hated his first version. He did. What was left was barely the same song. They called it "Loaded."

text: Jimmy Miller, who once produced the Stones.
The Orb, who turned one song into cosmic dub.
And him, holding it all together.
1992. The first Mercury Prize ever given.
A rock band, remade by a club DJ,
never expected dance music to stand.
slides.sub: A club DJ won where rock critics didn't expect it.
